member.name: M:Syncfusion.Telemetry.Telemetry.ShouldWaitForTelemetryFlush
member.summary: Determines whether telemetry flushes should be waited on synchronously.

Blazor WebAssembly doesn't support blocking operations at all. Console and background-thread scenarios continue to block so telemetry can be sent before the process exits.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Telemetry.TelemetrySanitizer
member.summary: Provides sanitization methods for telemetry data to ensure data quality and privacy.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Telemetry.TelemetrySanitizer.MaxNameLength
member.summary: Maximum allowed length for sanitized names.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Telemetry.TelemetrySanitizer.SafeName(System.String)
member.summary: Sanitizes a name by removing unsafe characters and truncating if necessary. Only alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, and dots are allowed.
member.param: The name to sanitize.
member.returns: The sanitized name, or "Unknown" if the input is null, empty, or contains no valid characters.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Telemetry.TelemetrySanitizer.ExtractFrameworkName(System.String)
member.summary: Extracts the framework name from the full framework description. Removes version information to get just the framework type.
member.param: The full framework description (e.g., ".NET 10.0.0.1" or ".NET Framework 4.8.1").
member.returns: The framework name without version (e.g., ".NET" or ".NET Framework"), or "Unknown" if input is invalid.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Telemetry.TelemetrySanitizer.FormatSdkName(System.String)
member.summary: Normalizes an SDK name by removing all spaces. Converts "Chart SDK" to "ChartSDK", keeps "DocumentSDK" as "DocumentSDK", etc.
member.param: The SDK name to normalize.
member.returns: The normalized SDK name without spaces, or the original value if null/empty.
member.remarks: Removes all spaces from the SDK name to ensure consistent formatting. Examples: - "DocumentSDK" → "DocumentSDK" - "GridSDK" → "GridSDK" - "Chart SDK" → "ChartSDK" - "My Custom SDK" → "MyCustomSDK"

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Telemetry.TelemetrySanitizer.ValidateAndNormalizeSdkName(System.String)
member.summary: Validates and normalizes an SDK name against the list of valid Syncfusion SDK names. Handles variations like "Chart SDK", "ChartsSDK", "Charts SDK" and maps them to "ChartSDK".
member.param: The SDK name to validate and normalize.
member.returns: The valid normalized SDK name if a match is found; otherwise, returns the formatted input SDK name for reporting.
member.remarks:
Valid SDK names are: - GridSDK - ChartSDK - DiagramSDK - RichTextEditorSDK - FileManagerSDK - GanttSDK - SchedulerSDK - SpreadsheetEditorSDK - DOCXEditorSDK - PDFViewerSDK - DocumentSDK
Examples: - "Chart SDK" → "ChartSDK" (valid) - "Charts SDK" → "ChartSDK" (corrected from typo) - "ChartSDK" → "ChartSDK" (valid) - "DOCX Editor SDK" → "DOCXEditorSDK" (valid)
